content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to [product_name] and looking for advice on a specific issue. I have two pushbuttons, each connected to a pulse relay. Pushbutton 1 is linked to PR 1, and pushbutton 2 to PR 2. Each pushbutton also operates the reset function of the other relay. When pushbutton 1 is pressed, the output for 1 is set to 1. If pushbutton 2 is pressed, the output for 1 resets to 0 and output for 2 becomes 1. However, I would prefer if when either output is active (set to 1), pressing the opposite button first resets both outputs to 0, and only a second press sets the desired output to 1. Let me know if this makes sense.
